[SWS_CM_00047] E2E Error Handler - Invocation Arguments
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00401, RS_CM_00402
⌈
In case no new request message is available,
E2EErrorHandler
shall be called with
the following arguments:
errorCode
shall be set to the
ComE2EErrc::kNoNewData
,
dataID
shall be set to
0
, and
messageCounter
shall be set
0
.
⌋
7.4.1.2.4 E2E protection of the service method response (Server)
